description: This is a Swift source file defining a static enum ModelCatalogLoader that provides functionality to load, resolve, cache, and sanitize a model catalog JavaScript file. It includes methods for file path resolution, JavaScript execution via JSContext, and parsing of model data into ModelChoice objects, with extensive logging.

methods.name: load(from:)
methods.description: Asynchronously loads a model catalog from a specified path, reads and sanitizes the JavaScript source, executes it within a JSContext, extracts model data, and returns sorted ModelChoice objects.

methods.name: resolveDefaultPath
methods.description: Resolves and returns the default path for the model catalog, preferring cached, bundled, or node modules location.

methods.name: resolvePath(preferred:)
methods.description: Resolves a preferred file path for the model catalog, with fallbacks to bundle and node modules paths, and determines caching needs.

methods.name: bundleCatalogPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the bundled 'models.generated.js' resource if available.

methods.name: nodeModulesCatalogPath
methods.description: Searches for the model catalog within node_modules directories in project root and current directory.

methods.name: cacheCatalog(sourcePath:)
methods.description: Caches the model catalog source file to the cache directory.

methods.name: sanitize(source:)
methods.description: Sanitizes the JavaScript source by extracting the 'MODELS' object and removing certain patterns.
